tissue_constraint_net.objective: Say, per pair of quantities, whether the relation is constrained by a measurement (TIGHT), measured to be insufficient or undetermined with the gap as the number (OPEN), or asserted in a model with nothing bearing on it (UNKNOWN).
tissue_constraint_net.schema_note: Same shape as vehicle_constraints and projector_constraints: variables with unit and level, edges with between, constraint, status and evidence. Additive — nothing was moved and no other net was touched.
